correctness.rationale: For the precisely smooth characteristic-seven octic family, derive the invariant quotient eta²=xi⁷+xi−2lambda xi⁴ and its diagonal genus-3 hyperelliptic Cartier matrix diag(lambda,2lambda−lambda³,lambda). All nonidentity order-seven translations fix only the single totally ramified infinity point, so Deuring–Shafarevich gives p-rank 7f(quotient), i.e., 0,14,21. For the full plane operator, exact coefficients of F^6 at exponents 7alpha−beta produce 21x21 blocks (1^4,2^4,3^3); determinants lambda for singletons and −lambda^d(lambda²−2) for d=2,3, with verified nonzero (d−1)-minors at lambda=3,4; rank exactly 0,14,21. Smoothness away from lambda=±1 is Theorem4.23 in arxiv:2202.05765. The stand-alone stdlib symbolic script recomputes the matrix, not merely finite experiments; a=21−rank.

value.rationale: Exactly determines two intrinsic arithmetic-geometric invariants throughout a distinguished natural PGL(2,7)-invariant genus-21 smooth plane octic pencil, strengthening the source’s generic ordinarity to a sharp arithmetic boundary. The intermediate a-number 7 is not inferable from just quotient p-rank; it exhibits smooth nonordinary members with a substantial Cartier kernel versus Hermitian superspecial degeneration and ordinary complement. The classification is meaningful even without Newton polygons or a paper-sized generalization.
